dashboard.label: AD Replication & Sync Health
dashboard.description: State of Active Directory replication between domain controllers: per-link status (last success, lag, last result) from MSAD:NT6:Replication, replication-related Directory Service and DFSR events (KCC, lingering objects, tombstone lifetime, DNS failures, USN rollback), sync start/end audit events, and Kerberos clock-skew failures.
